"All current workhand is moving to the Waterworks as instructed by the King himself. Until further notice, the mines will be closed off."
"Azsune finally came back home. She was away in Suramar for far too long!"
"Edril met with Elise at the Park, but Lelanna was nowhere to be found. The two were alone in there."
"Edril, in case you need the key for the gate, I'll leave it at the table near the fountain."

"Elise is dead. Lelanna is nowhere to be found and horrible things are starting to happen in our land. They speak of a demonic portal opened in Zin-Azshari... and that Feric is involved? Dark times are coming for us."
"Elise visits the park every afternoon to meet the people and read some of her books."
"Even the demons are afraid of what lurks below."
"Feric declared publicly today that he will personally execute Elise for treason. Everyone is shocked."
"Feric has been recieving letters much more often than usual. He always seems disturbed after reading them."
"Feric is not himself anymore. I can't even recognize him. And he goes like that just when we need him the most- with all these horrible things happening in Suramar..."
"Feric left for Zin-Azshari few days ago and returned today. Something sinister happened there."
"Feric refused to believe that there is nothing going on between Elise and Edril. Tommorow Edril will be executed."
"Feric somehow got convinced that Elise is cheating on him. He plans to execute her today!"
"General Riplash is not only leader of the Kalisean Army, but also a great advisor for Prince Feric."
"Great. Just great... Lysen dropped the key into the fire pot. How am I supposed to get it out now?"
"He whispers to me all the time."
"How could a simple handmaiden lead us to this?!"
"I am afraid I dropped the key for the Garden in the Well at the grove. I am sorry..."
"I blew them up! I blew them ALL UP!"
"I broke the pipes yesterday. I think some cogwheels broke on the inside, but I am not certain."
"I brought this wine here all the way from Suramar!"
"I have no idea how I ended up here..."
"I saw a fiery star fall down near Zultar Forest last night. If the place wasn't teeming with Trolls, I would've investigated."
"I saw a shield form above Suramar... They saved themselves... why didn't we conjure up one ourselves?!"
"I think I saw a Phoenix once... came down like a falling star. Must have been my eyes..."
"I visited Kalisea few days ago and noticed one of Elise's Handmaidens at the Park. I can't imagine anyone being more beautiful than that!"
"I was guarding the door and then I heard a noise..."
"Idrassil keeps growing strong. It's going to be the symbol of our nation and will give us strength!"
"In case of any potential danger, Bel'Shan was created to safeguard our people from any intruders."
"In his anger, Feric used a dagger to stab his own wife. They say her blood could not be wiped off from the blade."
"It was in this chamber that Feric murdered Elise... horrible memory."
"It was not the Legion that turned all the Night Elves of Kalisea into Naga. It was something else, and even thinking about it terrifies me."
"It was the Titans themselves that laid the foundations of this city."
"Kaldorei who are touched by the demonic influence of the Legion turn into Satyrs."
"King Feric ordered a relic to be sealed in a tomb in a way that only his own blood can open it."
"Lelanna actually dared set up Elise... I have to talk with her and see what kind of madness is this..."
"Lelanna confessed to me today that she has feelings for Feric... This information is nothing but a burden for me now..."
"Lelanna invited Elise and Edril at the Park. But she also told me that she plans not to be present there. I wonder what she is up to..."
"Lelanna is the newest handmaiden to Elise. She is always so gentle and shy..."
"Moon Bolts fired by Moon Guards have the ability to penetrate any armor."
"Moon Guards are capable of paralyzing a creature in a magical prison. It's only their own magic that can disable it."
"Murdering is going all over the place. Feric seems resolved to serve justice. Yet he's serving it on the wrong people..."

"Once per year the handmaidens of Elise cut off the old Vault Tree and pour Nightspring water onto it. If the tree is alive the next time they come to cut it off, the people of Kalisea are allowed to store their treasures in the Vault."
"One, two... Azsune is coming for you...."
"Our greatest treasures would be kept safe in the Treasure Room. They also plan to put magical protective towers here."
"Our security golem completely shut down and fell to pieces. Don't forget to take his Magnetic Orb so we can use it elsewhere."
"Prince Feric loved his wife, Elise, more than anything in his life."
"Queen Azshara has asked of us to double the refining of sea water within the Waterworks. Why would she need so much water?"
"Rumours started floating that Elise is cheating on Feric... Could it possibly be true?!"
"She did this because she loved him..."
"She's insane! Someone must stop her or this game of hers will end in blood.."
"The Essence of Darkness lingers within the graveyard."
"The Legion took Riplash away and we never saw him again..."
"The Legion will have trouble breaching the West Wing with all of our arcane traps laying around."
"The Northern water flow should be redirected as follows: <On, Off, On>"
"The Scepter wielded by Elise was a gift to her from Feric. It belonged to his mother and before her to every woman in the dynasty."
"The Southern water flow should be redirected as follows: <Off, On, On>"
"The gladiatorial battles in the Kalisean Arena are a spectacle to behold."
"The shaman Orax and I crashed here long ago. We couldn't tell the Warchief.. it was horrible."
"There are things going on in Zin-Azshari that are kept secret from us. I just know it, people have begun telling really creepy stories lately."
"There is noone left to revive the tree..."
"They brought in what seems to be a Titan construct. It is extremely dangerous as it instantly evaporated one of the men that tried to activate it. It's called Oris."
"This is the end that will never end."
"Three Royal Rubies were necessary to form an Imperial Ruby at the Vault."
"Trust me, you do not want to end up down there."
"We finally figured it out, the construct responds to
"We have stored some explosives in a room near the Waterworks entrance."
"We must leave the Essence of Light to be protected by Bel'shan. None other would keep it safer."
"Where is the damn map? I am sure I saw it somewhere nearby."
"While Elise and Edril were waiting at the Park, Feric came by and was furious... It seems odd to me that all three of them were at the same place at the same time, but Lelanna was missing?"
"While Suramar was always more beatiful and peaceful, Kalisea was surrounded by towering, unbreachable walls that gave the feeling of security."
"Why did you do this, my love...?"
"Yes, you guessed right. That thing ate me alive."
"Ysera and Nozdormu locked an object of great importance here before the Invasion began."
"Yup. Rumours were true. Trolls do eat your heart."

|c00cccc00Here are some instructions and functionalities regarding the Merchant shop:

|c00ff0000•|c00cccc00 Components appear in order of their stats. Complete items appear in alphabetical order.
|c00ff0000•|c00cccc00 You can use the category filters at the top section to narrow down the results.
|c00ff0000•|c00cccc00 The And/Or option at the top of the shop defines how you combine category filters.
|c00ff0000•|c00cccc00 The Inventory section contains all items in your Hero and Backpack inventories.
|c00ff0000•|c00cccc00 The shop can use any items from the Inventory section to fuse them into complete items.
|c00ff0000•|c00cccc00 A search bar is available at the top right, which allows additional filtering by item names.
|c00ff0000•|c00cccc00 A complete item can be acquired at any point of time, regardless of how many components you have for it.
|c00ff0000•|c00cccc00 You can Undo recent actions, but only while you have the Shop selected.

|c00eae311Edril:|r Bring him this Tiara. Let him fix it. Perhaps he'll finally find peace.
|c00eae311Edril:|r But even if he does not... don't give up. Help him if you can.
|c00eae311Edril:|r But what matters is that King Feric's soul still seeks release.
|c00eae311Edril:|r Feric regrets what he did to his wife. His spirit is restless and lost.
|c00eae311Edril:|r I witnessed the events that led to the destruction of Kalisea with my own eyes...
|c00eae311Edril:|r My name is Edril. Or atleast used to be... I was... friend of King Feric many centuries ago.
|c00eae311Engineer:|r Found anything that could pass for a cogwheel?
|c00eae311Engineer:|r Great, great indeed. But sadly we cannot move on.
|c00eae311Engineer:|r The elevator down there.. it's broken. I could fix it if I had a cogwheel...
|c00eae311Feric:|r Ah... my dear, is that you? Why is your tiara broken? I will remake it so you can have peace...
|c00eae311Feric:|r I finally see the light of the moon... Thank... you...
|c00eae311Haris:|r ... it would be more useful to you.
|c00eae311Haris:|r Ahh... Dark Lady watches over us.
|c00eae311Haris:|r Ahh... I've been waiting for some help.
|c00eae311Haris:|r Retrieve it for me and I will see what it has to say.
|c00eae311Haris:|r The Dark Lady sent me here to examine the tombstone of the dead King.
|c00eae311Haris:|r This stone can be used as a powerful reanimation tool. I'd gladly use it to create more Forsaken, but...
|c00eae311Kagar:|r Destroying the four obelisks will remove the wards and then his gate will be vulnerable.
|c00eae311Kagar:|r The coward, however, has sealed his gate with demonic wards which are in turn powered by obelisks in this area.
|c00eae311Kagar:|r We have a high ranked demon hiding behind his gate further down this corridor.
|c00eae311Kovin:|r These foul demons and their naga pets have corrupted it long ago!
|c00eae311Mysterious Wanderer:|r If you help me, I will reward you with a powerful item for each Titan Relic you bring me.
|c00eae311Mysterious Wanderer:|r My identitiy is of no concern for you. The only thing you need to know is that I am here to look for Titan Relics.
|c00eae311Mysterious Wanderer:|r To get them, you will likely need a Titanforged Hammer, which can only be fused at an Anvil with the aid of Elyrian Elixir. Good luck...
|c00eae311Mysterious Wanderer:|r Up to three |c00f28302Eyes of the Titans|r are rumoured to be locked within this city.
|c00eae311Nadrian:|r Here, take the vial with you. I imbued it for permanent use.
|c00eae311Nadrian:|r Let me do something for you in return.
|c00eae311Nadrian:|r There are four Altars that can slowly begin to cleanse it.
|c00eae311Nadrian:|r This place was used to purify sea water for everyday use.
|c00eae311Nadrian:|r This vial can fill them with the necessary powers to do so.
|c00eae311Nadrian:|r Use it on all four of them and then return it to me when you are done.
|c00eae311Nadrian:|r We are one of the last few survivors of the City...
|c00eae311Nadrian:|r We may yet have chance to cleanse this place.
|c00eae311Nandieb:|r Did you put her to rest?
|c00eae311Nandieb:|r I can cleanse her heart if you bring it to me.
|c00eae311Nandieb:|r Idrasill was almost destroyed 10000 years ago, but managed to survive. Now me and Illyana are protecting it.
|c00eae311Nandieb:|r It did, but I am afraid it is the reason for the Legion's persistent presence here.
|c00eae311Nandieb:|r It was my brother, Cevius, and you did well. His spirit was corrupted and he went insane.
|c00eae311Nandieb:|r It's done. Take this small seed as a symbol of my gratitude. Farewell...
|c00eae311Nandieb:|r Kill her and bring her heart to me. I will cleanse it.
|c00eae311Nandieb:|r Me and my daughter Illyana have spent centuries to regrow Idrasill.
|c00eae311Nandieb:|r Me and my daughter Illyana have spent centuries to regrow the World Tree Idrasill that you can see infront of us.
|c00eae311Nandieb:|r There is more. Azsune went insane over the centuries. Now she is a ruthless killer that lurks in the temple.
|c00eae311Nandieb:|r Welcome to the grove of Idrasill, General. I see you resisted the Legion's corruption.
|c00eae311Nandieb:|r Welcome to the grove of Idrasill, strangers.
|c00eae311Nandieb:|r World Trees need strong magical source to give them life. This City has the required magical energy to do that.
|c00eae311Nandieb:|r Yes, his spirit was tormented and went insane.
|c00eae311Nandieb:|r Yes, you can. There is a restless Night Elf called Azsune that went insane over the centuries. Now she is a ruthless killer that lurks in the temple.
|c00eae311Peon:|r Me thought that the woods came alive! Me got scared!
|c00eae311Warlord Trek:|r He hasn't returned. Look around for him and report back to me.
|c00eae311Warlord Trek:|r Is he dead? Bah... We needed an extra pair of hands.
|c00eae311Warlord Trek:|r One hour ago I sent a peon to harvest some lumber so we can salvage whatever we can.
|c00eae311Warlord Trek:|r Regardless, you did a good job. Take this gold as a reward.
|c00eae311Warlord Trek:|r You lazy peon... get back to work!
|c00eae311Witch Doctor:|r Ohh... dis be a Zandalari Relic! It will grant us a blessing, hold tight, mon!
|c00eae311Witch Doctor:|r What be dis thing you carry, mon?
|c00eccf11"A living seed of the World Tree Idrasill which was almost destroyed 10000 years ago before it could fully grow. Illyana will be interested in it."|r
